testimonials.subtitle: Stories of stress-free transfers.
testimonials.provisional: Placeholder testimonials for illustration; they will be replaced with verified reviews as soon as they are available.
testimonials.text1: The driver was waiting at the terminal with a name sign and helped with our bags. Spotless vehicle, air conditioning and exactly the price we were quoted.
testimonials.text2: The Havana to Varadero transfer was punctual, comfortable and with no surprises. We got our reference instantly and coordinating on WhatsApp was really easy.
testimonials.text3: We traveled with two kids and lots of luggage: the minivan had plenty of room and the hotel pickup was on time. The driver was very kind.
testimonials.text4: Everything went as agreed: fixed price in USD and cash payment on arrival, just as the website says. We will book with you again.
testimonials.name4: Clara and Toni · Buenos Aires, Argentina

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: In cash, when you arrive at your destination. No prepayment is required.
faq.q2: How much does a transfer cost?
faq.a2: The price is fixed per route and vehicle class and is shown in USD before you confirm.
faq.q3: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faq.a3: If your flight is delayed, message us on WhatsApp with the flight number and the estimated landing time: we reschedule the pickup without changing the fixed price of your booking. The free waiting time after landing is still to be finalized; we will publish it here as soon as it is confirmed.
faq.q4: How long will the driver wait?
faq.a4: Every pickup includes some waiting time at no charge; the exact number of minutes is pending final confirmation. For now we coordinate it via WhatsApp and state it on your booking confirmation. For airport pickups, the free wait after landing also applies (see the previous question).

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1: This is a placeholder privacy policy. The final text will be reviewed and approved before launch.
privacy.p2: We collect only the data needed to manage your transfer booking: name, contact details, pickup information and booking preferences.
privacy.p3: Your data is stored securely and used exclusively to fulfill your booking. We never sell your data to third parties.

terminos.title: Terms and Conditions
terminos.p1: This is a placeholder terms and conditions text. The final version will be reviewed and approved before public launch.
terminos.p2: The service is private transfers in Varadero and nearby areas, managed through this website. Submitting the booking form on the site is a request: it is recorded as pending and only becomes valid once you receive our confirmation.
terminos.p3: Prices are fixed by route and vehicle class, quoted in USD, and are shown before you confirm the booking. There are no hidden charges; EUR cash is also accepted on arrival.
terminos.p4: Payment is made in cash when you reach your destination, directly to the driver. No prepayment or card details are required.
terminos.p5: The customer is responsible for the accuracy of their contact details, pickup address and estimated time. Passengers and bags must not exceed the capacity of the selected vehicle.
terminos.p6: Cancellations and flight delays are handled according to the site's cancellation and refund policy.
terminos.p7: Personal data is collected and used exclusively to manage your booking, in line with the site's privacy policy.

cancelacion.title: Cancellation and Refund Policy
cancelacion.p1: This text is provisional: the final cancellation policy is pending business confirmation and will be published before public launch.
cancelacion.p2: Because payment happens in cash on arrival, nothing is charged in advance: there are no amounts pending refund at booking time.
cancelacion.p3: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the pickup time, notifying us via WhatsApp at the site's contact number and quoting the VT- reference of your booking.
cancelacion.p4: Requests cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice are assessed case by case, depending on the driver's waiting time already committed, until the final waiting policy is confirmed.
cancelacion.p5: Flight delay: message us on WhatsApp with your flight number and we reschedule the pickup at no cost, as long as the delay is on the same day as the booking.
cancelacion.p6: If you do not show up (no-show) without notice, the booking is cancelled; the definitive policy will be confirmed before launch.
cancelacion.p7: In cases of force majeure (weather, airport closure, emergencies), each case is handled individually, seeking the fairest solution for both parties.
